Member Spotlight
This page from the International Cheese Federation features a collection of 'Member Spotlight' articles, showcasing diverse professionals within the cheese industry. The spotlights cover various aspects of the business, including affineur practices, retail strategies, supply chain management, farmstead operations, food safety training, and advocacy efforts, providing insights into the daily realities and challenges faced by members.
